meta.name: model-savings
meta.description: Estimate the dollars saved by routing eligible Claude Code work to a cheaper model family, using the Agent Monitor pricing engine. Re-prices each model's token mix at the target family's rates and quantifies the delta. Uses /api/pricing (rates), /api/pricing/cost (current per-model spend), /api/sessions, and /api/analytics. Use when hunting for cost cuts or comparing model tiers.
